morphology.pattern_note: is_root 与 root_word 沿用输入标注，不代表已确认其为标准马来语词根。若指 Tolkien 作品中的 Gondor，应按专名整词记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分。

senses.zh_definition: 条件性专名解读：若原文指大写 Gondor，则为托尔金中土世界中的虚构王国“刚铎”；输入的小写形式尚未确认为标准马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: Provisionally, Gondor, a fictional kingdom in Tolkien's Middle-earth; the supplied lowercase form is not verified as a standard Malay common noun.
senses.ms_definition: Jika yang dimaksudkan ialah nama khas Gondor, nama ini merujuk sebuah kerajaan rekaan dalam dunia Middle-earth ciptaan J. R. R. Tolkien; bentuk huruf kecil yang diberikan belum disahkan sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 这是有依据的候选专名解读，不是已证实的输入词义。未获得原始语境，不能据此排除其他来源；因此不标记 official，也不补造规范音标或爪夷文。以下搭配和例句仅适用于此专名解读，未宣称具备语料频率依据。[Tolkien Estate：Gondor 与 Aragorn](https://www.tolkienestate.com/scholarship/arden-smith-writing-systems/)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied lowercase form has no established etymology in the evidence provided. A plausible contextual interpretation is Tolkien's proper name Gondor, which appears in his fictional geography and in descriptions of Aragorn's kingship. That literary identification does not establish an ordinary Malay word, so its history must remain separate from the unresolved identity of this input. [Tolkien Estate: maps](https://www.tolkienestate.com/es/ilustrar/mapas/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若语境是《魔戒》，将 Gondor 与“刚铎王国”配对记忆；无语境时保留待核实标记。
